nodes.motivation: Test the painter hypothesis: because the write bandwidth per pass is bounded by M*edges, sequential passes onto a persistent canvas, each conditioned on the accumulated field and the write step, should accumulate detail the way iterative refinement does, instead of stamping one attractor.

Canvas persistence causality is perfect everywhere: blanking the canvas at the final step yields a blank output (IoU 0.000-0.001), so every step demonstrably reads the accumulated field. Yet the step index is never causal: constant-t ablations match the full schedule to the last digit in every cell, even with a trained t_coord and the trained step-conditioned prior (learned projection norms only 0.02-0.04). Write sharpening improves per-step tracking (peak step IoU 0.518 at gamma 8 versus 0.408) but not composition, and the per-step IoU plateaus then decays over the no-op tail. Mechanistic reading: the set-point write X += proj(mu_p - S(X)) composes across passes only if S(X) is a faithful latent read of the canvas; the same diffuse-assignment lossiness that bounded single-shot high-frequency bandwidth makes the residual mu_p - S unable to express target-minus-canvas, so repeated writes converge to one attractor rather than accumulating strokes. Sequential refinement is not free; it is gated by latent read fidelity.

nodes.title: Event-norm port angle replaces the reflection-locked pointwise law
nodes.motivation: The first real joint updates showed the write port stuck near total reflection (acceptance 0.57% falling to 3-6%, write angle 0.036-0.12 rad over 440 updates): the angle consumed the per-site innovation magnitude, so a unit-norm token's innovation is grid-and-channel averaged down to ~0.04 and the initial admittance 0.69 could only ever produce ~0.036 rad. Opening the port would require the admittance to grow more than tenfold for numerical reasons, locking the training direction regardless of what the predictor learns.
nodes.action: Abandoned the affected run at step 440 and replaced the angle law: theta_c = atan(Y_c * ||delta||_Pi) with ||delta||_Pi the precision-weighted event-total innovation norm (site-averaged, hence grid-resolution independent), and the unit direction delta/||delta||_Pi as the incident mode, implemented in a division-free form that is smooth at zero innovation. Null innovation remains the exact identity rotation; accepted_fraction is now the Pi-weighted transmission of the unit incident mode, and the raw incident/reflected/accepted energies remain the boundary ledger. Logged innovation_norm and write_admittance_mean per step so prior quality, innovation size, and admittance can be distinguished while training.
nodes.conclusion: Structural only: exact rotation ledger on (field, unit incident mode), exact identity at zero innovation, resolution-independent event norm and angle across grids, and at the registered d=128 calibration an unpredictable token has ||delta||_Pi ~ 1 giving a finite exchange at initial admittance. No capability claim; the joint 3000-update rerun must show whether the opened port improves NLL, write free energy, and readout accuracy together.
issues: Precision growth raises ||delta||_Pi for the same physical innovation; the joint dynamics must regulate admittance and precision rather than the angle saturating.

The transmitted amplitude saturates at one unit-norm mode per event, so a single event can never overwrite the field arbitrarily; the resulting NESS field level is higher than under the closed port and must be watched for stability.

The event norm is exactly resolution independent only through the chart's per-mode RMS normalization; the writer's channel_scale calibration still sets the dimensionless unit at d=128.
nodes.invalidation: Reject this fix if, at unit event norms, the port still cannot open (transmission stays near zero across training) or if opening destabilizes token NLL instead of reducing it.
nodes.confidence_note: Scale mismatch was measured on the first 440 real updates; the replacement law is unit-tested structurally. The training consequence is unverified until the rerun reports.

nodes.title: Unified three-layer field-only bath and K=16 integrator for the port line

The three layers are passive contraction semigroups composed once per microstep, so the retired three-clock scheduling is irrelevant to their validity; the layers, not the clocks, carry the value.
nodes.action: Expose --dissipation-type/--dissipation-rank in the K64 trainer. Layer-2 viscosity adds another per-microstep FFT on a latency-bound GPU; the rfftn half-spectrum transform applies there too and is deferred.
Subspace forgetting must remain field-only; a token-conditioned context would violate the single-write-path discipline.
The two arms differ only in the bath, so four-site NLL, write free energy and field-energy traces are directly comparable.

DURATION ladder (dt=tau0 fixed, T=K*tau0): NLL 9.153 (K=64, T=64tau0), 9.262 (K=16), 9.491 (K=4), 9.626 (K=1), evaluation 402/154/92/76 s. The posterior precision mean grew from ~1.4 at step 1 to ~55 by step 3000 while the port stayed near 0.60 acceptance: the Pi-weighted event norm inflates with precision growth, so a future T action must condition on a normalized or logged signal rather than the raw norm.

So read positions are learnable, DO bind to processing (the user's 'position determines how it is read' is real), but the binding is weak and barely re-located from initialization - the read side is position-agnostic to first order, which is consistent with transport idleness. nodes.title: Spatial collapse: the language-trained W4 field is exactly uniform
nodes.motivation: Explain the measured causal idleness of transport. The two-ball complementarity requires locality: collision is site-local, so transport must create co-location events for the pair to matter.
nodes.action: Measure the spectral energy distribution and site-vector geometry of the mature fields on both architecture lines.
nodes.conclusion: The W4 language-trained field carries 100.00% of its spectral energy in the DC mode (spatially constant) and all 256 site vectors are identical to the field mean (cosine 1.000, std 0.000): the field has zero spatial degrees of freedom in use, and the torus operates as one replicated 128-dimensional recurrent state. The W2 champion's field retains 38.79 percent non-DC energy and site cosines 0.748 plus-or-minus 0.080. Transport idleness is therefore trivial for the W4 line - a uniform field is a fixed point of streaming - and is placement redundancy for the W2 line. Mechanism: the W4 chart includes the constant DC mode, gradient pressure concentrates the gates there, a uniform field is a fixed point of all three interior operators, and language provides no geometric signal to pay for spatial structure.
issues: Within-event localization of the kill point (trace on one real token): the W4 write is INNOCENT - chart gates spread over all 8 modes (DC lowest at 0.058), observed/predicted/innovation packets are 96.5 percent spatial, and the field jumps from 100.00 percent DC to 96.22 percent spatial at the write. The FIRST interior microstep (unified bath spectral viscosity at dt=4) collapses spatial energy to 1.64 percent, microstep 2 to 0.00 percent; the readout never sees differentiation. Consequence: microsteps 2-16 are literal no-ops on the resulting uniform field (transport is identity at k=0, collision is identical per site). The W2 champion's quadratic bath preserves its 38 percent structure across all 3 microsteps (38.28 -> 38.27 percent). Write and readout are exonerated; the bath is the sole within-event killer, consistent with the across-training 2x2.

Analytic closure: on the v4 checkpoint the learned nu stayed at its 0.020 initialization (no NLL pressure to preserve structure), so the spectral viscosity alone gives every non-DC Fourier mode a per-event survival factor exp(-T*nu*lambda_max) = 1.5e-7 at T=64*tau0 versus 0.479 at the old line's T=3*tau0, while DC (lambda(0)=0 by design) is only uniformly damped (0.43 per event) and is continuously re-fed by global-mode writes. The measured DC shares (100.00 percent unified at T=64, 38.79 percent quadratic at T=3) match this analytically. The unified bath is therefore a DC attractor by construction at long event durations: its monotone k-selective damping has no regeneration term. Fix options: revert to the quadratic bath at long T, make the viscosity duration-invariant so T stays a pure duration axis, restrict the unified bath to short-T regimes, or pair it with localized writes that re-inject structure faster than it is damped.

CAUSE ISOLATED by the 2x2 across arms: both unified-bath arms collapse to 100.00% DC regardless of write (W2-modern 7.8922 and W4 v4 7.4203), while both quadratic-bath arms retain rich structure (old champion 38.79 percent, v2 step-500 76.26 percent) regardless of write and K/T. The unified bath's spectral-viscosity layer is the structure annihilator at T=64*tau0; the write law and the integrator are exonerated. The main-architecture declaration's bath choice is reopened: quadratic is the structure-preserving candidate and a W4+quadratic 3000-update reproduction run is launched (results/q8_w4_quadratic_k16_3000) - the never-run cell of the matrix that must reproduce low NLL with surviving spatial structure.
For pure language NLL, spatial structure is a measured COST: the structured W2-modern field scores 7.8922 versus the collapsed uniform W4 field at 7.4203.
The declared main line for language is therefore effectively a reduced recurrent system; its spatial machinery is unexercised rather than wrong.
Restoring locality requires a localized innovation write (gate regularization toward wavepacket superpositions or explicit addressing) plus narrow probes, at a short-term NLL cost.
The spatial machinery of the field architecture can only be validated on data with intrinsic geometry (next-frame prediction, segmentation, editing) in the capability matrix.
The W2 champion retains spatial structure without transport contribution, so its structure is decorative for NLL but demonstrates that addressed writes prevent collapse.
nodes.invalidation: Revise if a localized-write variant shows spatial structure surviving training WITH an NLL improvement, or if the uniformity measurement is an artifact of the saved state rather than the running dynamics.
nodes.confidence_note: Direct spectral measurement on both saved mature states; the collapse mechanism is inferred from operator structure and training pressure, not yet isolated by intervention.

nodes.title: Spectral viscosity analytically forces DC collapse at T=64
nodes.motivation: Resolve whether the two-arm 100% DC observation identifies a trained preference, a write/read defect, or a necessary consequence of the unified bath.
nodes.action: Derive the exact Fourier multiplier of the implemented spectral-viscosity layer and encode it as a deterministic operator test on the fundamental torus mode.
nodes.conclusion: For a Fourier coefficient k, the implemented field-only layer applies exp(-T*nu*|k|^2). At the registered unit-torus duration T=64 and initialized nu=0.02, the slowest non-DC amplitude is exp(-64*0.02*(2*pi)^2)=1.1e-22 and its quadratic energy ratio is 1.3e-44. DC has |k|^2=0 and therefore survives. The new operator test verifies one exact dt=4 attenuation and verifies that 16 microsteps drive the fundamental below 1e-30 energy, the FP64 FFT floor. This predicts the completed 2x2 spectrum exactly: both unified arms are 100% DC independent of W2/W4, while both quadratic arms retain non-DC structure.
issues: The uniform leakage and rank-R content term are distinct mechanisms; the present result assigns the collapse to raw spectral viscosity, not to the entire idea of field-only dissipation.

A future scale-calibrated diffusion study may set nu by its dimensionless product T*nu*(2*pi/L)^2 and register its retained-mode spectrum before language training. It is an optional transport/smoothing study, not the default NESS bath.
The decisive remaining capability experiment is W4 plus quadratic local bath for 3000 registered updates at K=64, followed by the four-site warm-local evaluation and Fourier spectrum measurement.
